name: Crescendo ~Eien da to Omotte Ita Ano Koro~
original_name: Crescendo ～永遠だと思っていたあの頃～
source:
It's five days before graduation, and Sasaki Ryou is in school, making up the hours needed to graduate with the other members of his class. For Ryou, it's a quiet time to sit and reflect on the past year and all that has happened. As he thinks back on the past year, he remembers all his friends ... Kaho, who dragged him into the literary arts club against his will. Kaho's strange friend Kyouko, who was secretly in love with him. The oddly antisocial Yuka, so cheerful and yet secretly ashamed of something. His step-sister Ayame, who took such good care of him after their parents died. And the sexy school nurse Kaori, who always had a healing word for him. Every day held real experiences leaving real memories ... days he thought would last forever.

Now the day of graduation draws near, and Ryou knows that he must prepare himself to make a choice.

[Edited from [url=https://jastusa.com/games/gc014/crescendo?via=vndb]JAST USA[/url]]
translation:
距离毕业只剩五天，佐佐木凉仍和班上其他同学留在学校，补足毕业所需的课时。对凉而言，这是一段能够静下心来回望过去一年、细数种种往事的时间。他想起了身边的每一个人：不顾他的意愿，硬把他拉进文艺部的加穗；加穗那位性格古怪、暗中爱慕着他的朋友恭子；有些不合群、表面开朗，心底却为某件事深感羞耻的由香；父母去世后一直悉心照顾他的继妹绫女；以及性感的校医香织，她总会用温柔的话语抚慰他。每一天都曾带来真实的经历，留下真实的回忆……那些他以为会永远延续的时光。

如今毕业之日渐渐逼近，凉知道，自己必须做好作出选择的准备。
